<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="סיון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918994_theRebbe_134" batchId="meluket-_D7_A1_D7_99_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918994_theRebbe_134__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the power to refine physical matter belongs specifically to souls, not angels, and correlates the four categories of creation with the four letters of the Tetragrammaton, detailing the distinct origins and relationships of these categories.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, the power to rectify and elevate even a physical and corporeal body is not within the power of the angels, but specifically within the power of the souls.</t>
    <t s="2">And the explanation is34,</t>
    <t s="3">that,</t>
    <t s="4">the entirety of creation is divided into four categories: inanimate, vegetative, animate, and speaking,</t>
    <t s="5">in which are also included the angels and souls.</t>
    <t s="6">And these four categories correspond to the four letters of the Name Havayah35.</t>
    <t s="7">And although sometimes it is explained36</t>
    <t s="8">the difference between angels and souls,</t>
    <t s="9">that the root of angels is from the Name Elokim,</t>
    <t s="10">as it is said37</t>
    <t s="11">"Give thanks to the God of gods,"</t>
    <t s="12">and the root of souls is from the Name Havayah,</t>
    <t s="13">as it is said38</t>
    <t s="14">"For the portion of Havayah is His people,"</t>
    <t s="15">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="16">in a more general sense,</t>
    <t s="17">even the angels have their root from the Name Havayah,</t>
    <t s="18">for Havayah means "He who brings into being"39,</t>
    <t s="19">and He brings into being the entirety of all existences.</t>
    <t s="20">Therefore, the four categories in creation are included in the Name Havayah,</t>
    <t s="21">which has four letters,</t>
    <t s="22">corresponding to which are the four categories.</t>
    <t s="23">The final Hei,</t>
    <t s="24">the aspect of Malchus,</t>
    <t s="25">is the matter of the inanimate category.</t>
    <t s="26">The Vav,</t>
    <t s="27">the aspect of the emotions,</t>
    <t s="28">is the matter of the vegetative category,</t>
    <t s="29">for the emotions grow from smallness to greatness.</t>
    <t s="30">The first Hei,</t>
    <t s="31">the aspect of Binah,</t>
    <t s="32">is the matter of the animate category,</t>
    <t s="33">as it is said regarding Chavah40</t>
    <t s="34">"She was the mother of all life,"</t>
    <t s="35">which refers to the Sefirah of Binah,</t>
    <t s="36">and on a higher level it also refers to the aspect of the externality of Chochmah,</t>
    <t s="37">for even the externality of Chochmah is included in the animate category,</t>
    <t s="38">as it is said41</t>
    <t s="39">"And wisdom gives life"</t>
    <t s="40">(That is,</t>
    <t s="41">that in Chochmah there are two levels,</t>
    <t s="42">the Yud and the point of the Yud,</t>
    <t s="43">and the explanation that even Chochmah is in the animate category,</t>
    <t s="44">as it is said "and wisdom gives life,"</t>
    <t s="45">refers to the aspect of the externality of Chochmah).</t>
    <t s="46">And even the angels are called by the names vegetative and animate,</t>
    <t s="47">as it is said42</t>
    <t s="48">"Then all the trees of the forest will sing,"</t>
    <t s="49">and likewise they are called by the names beasts, animals, and birds43,</t>
    <t s="50">as it is said44</t>
    <t s="51">"The face of a lion... and the face of an ox from the left... and the face of an eagle."</t>
    <t s="52">And the letter Yud and its point,</t>
    <t s="53">the aspect of the innerness of Chochmah,</t>
    <t s="54">corresponds to the intellectual soul,</t>
    <t s="55">the speaking soul.</t>
    <t s="56">Now,</t>
    <t s="57">the letters Vav and first Hei have a connection with each other,</t>
    <t s="58">just as with the vegetative and animate, which are close to each other,</t>
    <t s="59">for the animate has the aspect of growth.</t>
    <t s="60">And so it is also regarding the emotions and the intellect, which are close to each other.</t>
    <t s="61">However, the final Hei,</t>
    <t s="62">the aspect of Malchus,</t>
    <t s="63">has no closeness with the Vav and the first Hei,</t>
    <t s="64">and its coming into being is from Chochmah,</t>
    <t s="65">the innerness of Chochmah,</t>
    <t s="66">as per the statement45</t>
    <t s="67">"Abba founded the daughter,"</t>
    <t s="68">except that this coming into being is in a manner of distance.</t>
    <t s="69">And just as the coming into being of Chochmah itself is in a manner of distance,</t>
    <t s="70">as it is said46</t>
    <t s="71">"And wisdom, from where is it found?"</t>
    <t s="72">for it is known that the coming into being of Chochmah from that which is above Chochmah is not similar to the coming into being of the Sefiros that are below Chochmah,</t>
    <t s="73">like the coming into being of Binah from Chochmah,</t>
    <t s="74">and likewise the emotions from Binah,</t>
    <t s="75">and likewise the innerness of Malchus from the emotions,</t>
    <t s="76">for their coming into being is in a manner of cause and effect,</t>
    <t s="77">but the coming into being of Chochmah from that which is above Chochmah is in a manner of yesh mei'ayin (existence from nothing),</t>
    <t s="78">and this means that the innerness of Chochmah is connected to the Ayin (Nothingness) from which it is found</t>
    <t s="79">(for what is said "and wisdom gives life" is in the aspect of the externality of Chochmah,</t>
    <t s="80">and what is said "and wisdom, from where is it found?" is in the aspect of the innerness of Chochmah,</t>
    <t s="81">the Mah of Chochmah),</t>
    <t s="82">as it is explained in Tanya47</t>
    <t s="83">that the level of Chochmah is the sensation that He alone is and there is nothing besides Him,</t>
    <t s="84">and likewise it is also regarding the matter of "Abba founded the daughter"45,</t>
    <t s="85">that the coming into being of Malchus</t>
    <t s="86">(the externality of Malchus,</t>
    <t s="87">the speech of Malchus)</t>
    <t s="88">from the innerness of Chochmah is in a manner of distance.</t>
    <t s="89">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="90">that the externality of Malchus is the aspect of the letters,</t>
    <t s="91">and the coming into being of the letters is not from the emotions and from the intellect in a manner of cause and effect,</t>
    <t s="92">as is known from the proofs regarding this,</t>
    <t s="93">for if it were said that the coming into being of the letters is from the emotions or from the intellect,</t>
    <t s="94">it would be necessary that the intellect of kindness and the intellect of judgment would be in different letters,</t>
    <t s="95">but in actuality we see that in those same letters themselves, both the intellect of kindness and the intellect of judgment are clothed,</t>
    <t s="96">and only the combination of the letters changes, but the letters themselves are the same in both.</t>
    <t s="97">And furthermore,</t>
    <t s="98">it is stated in the Zohar48</t>
    <t s="99">and in the Mikdash Melech that there are letters of kindness and letters of judgment,</t>
    <t s="100">and if so,</t>
    <t s="101">surely it would have to be that the intellect of kindness would specifically clothe itself in letters of kindness,</t>
    <t s="102">and likewise the opposite,</t>
    <t s="103">but we see that this is not the case.</t>
    <t s="104">And from this it is proven that the coming into being of the letters is not from the intellect, and certainly not from the emotions,</t>
    <t s="105">but rather they have a root of their own,</t>
    <t s="106">and from the aspect of their essential root there are letters of kindness and letters of judgment,</t>
    <t s="107">and their root is in the Kadmus HaSechel (the Antecedence of the Intellect)49</t>
    <t s="108">(which is above the intellect),</t>
    <t s="109">as is known regarding the matter of "Abba founded the daughter,"</t>
    <t s="110">that the drawing down of the letters</t>
    <t s="111">(the daughter)</t>
    <t s="112">from Chochmah</t>
    <t s="113">(Abba)</t>
    <t s="114">is from the aspect of Kadmus HaSechel.</t>
    <t s="115">And the coming into being of the letters from Kadmus HaSechel is in a manner of distance50.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section contrasts the creation of vegetative and animate beings, whose body and soul were created together, with the creation of man, whose body was formed first and then infused with a soul, highlighting the superiority of the speaking being.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And along these lines is also the difference between the vegetative and animate and the speaking,</t>
    <t s="1">that in the vegetative and animate, their body and soul are proportionate to each other and came into being</t>
    <t s="2">(the body and the soul)</t>
    <t s="3">together,</t>
    <t s="4">as it is said "Let the earth sprout..."51</t>
    <t s="5">"Let the earth bring forth..."52,</t>
    <t s="6">and also regarding the creations of the hidden world it is written "Let the waters swarm..."53,</t>
    <t s="7">that they were all created as they are now,</t>
    <t s="8">and as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said54</t>
    <t s="9">"They were created in their full stature and in their full form."</t>
    <t s="10">And so it is with the angels, whose body and soul came into being as one.</t>
    <t s="11">However, in the creation of man, his body was first made on its own without any living soul within it,</t>
    <t s="12">as it is said55</t>
    <t s="13">"And Havayah Elokim formed the man, dust from the ground,"</t>
    <t s="14">and as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said56</t>
    <t s="15">"In the first hour his dust was gathered, in the second an unformed mass was made"</t>
    <t s="16">(as it is said57</t>
    <t s="17">"Your unformed mass saw Your eyes"),</t>
    <t s="18">and only afterwards "He blew into his nostrils the breath of life"55.</t>
    <t s="19">For seemingly this is a deficiency, that for a period of time the body of man was an unformed mass,</t>
    <t s="20">but in truth,</t>
    <t s="21">behold, from this very thing we see the superiority of the speaking category,</t>
    <t s="22">that the soul of man, which is higher than the soul of the angels,</t>
    <t s="23">specifically clothes itself in the body of man,</t>
    <t s="24">which is the most lowly body,</t>
    <t s="25">in the manner that the coming into being of the letters is specifically from the innerness of Chochmah,</t>
    <t s="26">for "their beginning is wedged in their end and their end in their beginning"58.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the superiority of the human soul over angels, rooted in the soul's origin from the Name Havayah and the innerness of the vessels, which are unified with the essential light and therefore without limitation.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">And an explanation of the superiority of the soul of man over the soul of the angels,</t>
    <t s="2">behold, it was explained above that the root of angels is from the Name Elokim,</t>
    <t s="3">and the root of souls is from the Name Havayah.</t>
    <t s="4">And from this, with additional explanation, the reason will be understood why the song of the angels is heard by the ears of the prophet and not the song of the souls,</t>
    <t s="5">because the angels, whose root is from the Name Elokim36,</t>
    <t s="6">are the aspect of the vessels,</t>
    <t s="7">and the vessels are in measurement and limitation,</t>
    <t s="8">but the souls, whose root is from the Name Havayah36,</t>
    <t s="9">are the aspect of the lights,</t>
    <t s="10">and the lights are not in measurement and limitation,</t>
    <t s="11">to the point that sometimes it is explained59</t>
    <t s="12">that the lights are simple.</t>
    <t s="13">And also according to what is explained elsewhere60</t>
    <t s="14">that even the souls have their root from the vessels,</t>
    <t s="15">behold, it is known that the root of the souls is from the innerness of the vessels61.</t>
    <t s="16">And the difference between the innerness of the vessels and the externality of the vessels is like what we see also in vessels below,</t>
    <t s="17">that the innerness of the vessel is unified with the liquid inside it,</t>
    <t s="18">but the externality of the vessel,</t>
    <t s="19">behold, the inner wall of the vessel separates between the liquid and the externality of the vessel.</t>
    <t s="20">And also the entire matter of the externality of the vessel is in order to bring the liquid to the place one desires,</t>
    <t s="21">meaning that its purpose is for the sake of another,</t>
    <t s="22">that is, for the sake of revelation.</t>
    <t s="23">And this is regarding vessels that are external to the person.</t>
    <t s="24">And likewise regarding the vessels within the person himself, which are the limbs,</t>
    <t s="25">behold, the externality of the vessel is not comparable to the innerness of the vessel,</t>
    <t s="26">for example, in the vessel of the brain,</t>
    <t s="27">that the externality of the brain, its purpose is to influence another,</t>
    <t s="28">behold, besides the fact that the entire matter of influence is only externality,</t>
    <t s="29">for "the inner content of the heart, people do not write"62,</t>
    <t s="30">and "it does not stand on the mind of his teacher"63,</t>
    <t s="31">behold, also the externality itself,</t>
    <t s="32">when the listener is not an intellectual, the influence will not benefit him at all,</t>
    <t s="33">as per the saying "one cannot put a head on someone"64,</t>
    <t s="34">and only when he himself is an intellectual will he receive the influence from his teacher.</t>
    <t s="35">And the reason for this is,</t>
    <t s="36">because the entire matter of influence from the externality of the vessel is only externality,</t>
    <t s="37">meaning only a radiation,</t>
    <t s="38">and not in a manner that gives him the essence.</t>
    <t s="39">However, regarding the matter of the influence of the drop, which is from the innerness of the brain,</t>
    <t s="40">behold, through this he begets something similar to himself,</t>
    <t s="41">because it is an essential influence.</t>
    <t s="42">And this is because the innerness of the brain is unified with the innerness of the light.</t>
    <t s="43">And the reason that this is so below,</t>
    <t s="44">behold, it is because this is so also above,</t>
    <t s="45">that the externality of the vessels is only a radiation,</t>
    <t s="46">and the innerness of the vessels is unified with the innerness of the light,</t>
    <t s="47">even with the aspect of the essence of the light,</t>
    <t s="48">which is Ein Sof.</t>
    <t s="49">And from this the superiority of the souls over the angels is understood,</t>
    <t s="50">that the souls, whose root is from the innerness of the vessels that are unified with the essence of the light,</t>
    <t s="51">have no limitations at all.</t>
    <t s="52">Behold,</t>
    <t s="53">an angel is limited in place,</t>
    <t s="54">as per the statement "an angel stands in a third of the world"65,</t>
    <t s="55">and likewise it is limited in time,</t>
    <t s="56">for time and place are related to each other66.</t>
    <t s="57">However, souls are not limited either in place or in time,</t>
    <t s="58">and this is what is said67</t>
    <t s="59">"And holy ones every day they praise You, Selah,"</t>
    <t s="60">whereas before this,</t>
    <t s="61">in the recitation of "Holy, blessed, He will reign"68,</t>
    <t s="62">"Selah" is not said,</t>
    <t s="63">and this is because "Holy, blessed, He will reign" refers to the song of the Seraphim, Chayos, and Ofanim,</t>
    <t s="64">whose song is in limitation,</t>
    <t s="65">for there is an interruption in their song,</t>
    <t s="66">but "And holy ones every day they praise You, Selah" refers to the song of the souls,</t>
    <t s="67">whose song is every day,</t>
    <t s="68">and furthermore,</t>
    <t s="69">the song is "Selah,"</t>
    <t s="70">for "every place where Netzach, Selah, and Va'ed are stated, it has no cessation"69.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
